# Reconfigurable_Neuromorphic_Acceleration

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The use of FPGA reconfigurability to adapt hardware resources for different SNN topologies and spike-coding schemes, enabling flexible in-network neuromorphic processing. Supports dynamic adaptation of network architectures in TCC/iNEST environments, allowing hardware to evolve with changing computational demands.
